description: A painting in dark, heavy oil style. In the foreground at right, a black vintage ticker or adding machine with a rounded top spills long white paper tape that curls and loops onto a wooden surface. Behind it, a crowd of people holding black umbrellas stands in heavy rain. On the left, a draped stand with red, white and blue bunting is empty. In the background a domed white capitol building with a columned facade sits under a stormy grey sky.
